page.text:
The quantifier $\exists!$ is the logical license for introducing
*definite descriptions* and functional notations. In his landmark 1905
theory of descriptions, Bertrand Russell emphasized that an expression
such as 'the identity element of $G$' or 'the limit of $f(x)$ as
$x \to a$' is meaningless unless both existence and uniqueness have been
established.
